sourceQuote: The Foreign Physical Examination Record is invalid if it is incomplete, without the signature of the doctor and the official stamp of the hospital, or without the photo of the applicant and the cross-page seal on the photo.
targetQuote: 境外体格检查记录表如有以下情形，则无效：填写不完整、缺少医生签名或医院公章、缺少申请人照片或照片未加盖骑缝章。
